findings.evidence: shall lock a Member account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts
findings.rationale: Lock duration, notification and unlock/recovery procedure are not stated.

findings.evidence: the Notification Service shall notify him by email
findings.rationale: 'him' could refer to the Librarian, the Member, or the Guarantor.

findings.evidence: expire password-reset tokens TBD minutes after issuance
findings.rationale: Token expiry value is an explicit placeholder.

findings.evidence: user-friendly Member dashboard that is easy to navigate and loads rapidly on standard connections
findings.rationale: 'user-friendly', 'easy to navigate', 'rapidly' and 'standard connections' have no testable threshold.

findings.evidence: at most TBD consecutive times
findings.rationale: Renewal limit is an explicit placeholder.

findings.evidence: validate item eligibility within 2 seconds and issue the loan receipt
findings.rationale: No behaviour is specified when the item is ineligible or validation fails/times out.

findings.evidence: the allowed maximum number of active hold requests
findings.rationale: The hold cap is referenced but no number is given anywhere in the document.

findings.evidence: borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously
findings.rationale: SD-009 limits a Member in good standing to at most 5 physical items.

findings.evidence: standard loan period for circulating print books to 21 calendar days
findings.rationale: SD-010 sets the standard loan duration for the same items to 14 calendar days.

findings.evidence: self-register online with only an email address and immediately check out physical books without Librarian ID verification
findings.rationale: SD-001 requires Librarian verification of photo ID and full name, email and phone before account creation.

findings.evidence: shall remain held indefinitely until the requesting Member explicitly cancels the hold
findings.rationale: SD-011 cancels uncollected holds after exactly 72 hours.

findings.evidence: send an overdue email and/or suspend borrowing privileges and/or apply a penalty flag
findings.rationale: Chained 'and/or' leaves unclear which actions are required in which combination.

findings.evidence: shall be reviewed, approved, and recorded with a reason code
findings.rationale: Passive voice gives no role or component that reviews and approves waiver requests.

findings.evidence: before the due date if appropriate
findings.rationale: 'if appropriate' makes the obligation optional; the lead time before the due date is also unspecified.

findings.evidence: retain payment receipts for TBD years
findings.rationale: Retention period is an explicit placeholder.

findings.evidence: $1.25 USD per overdue day per item with no maximum cap
findings.rationale: SD-019 sets the fine at $0.50 per day capped at $20.00 per item.

findings.evidence: renew borrowed items online at any time regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance
findings.rationale: SD-020 blocks renewing when the unpaid fine balance exceeds $5.00.

findings.evidence: each Patron's active loan count ... on the Patron profile screen
findings.rationale: 'Patron' is used for the entity named 'Member' throughout earlier requirements.

findings.evidence: return search results quickly even when many users are querying
findings.rationale: 'quickly' and 'many users' are unquantified.

findings.evidence: where possible
findings.rationale: Loophole qualifier makes highlighting optional and untestable.

findings.evidence: sufficient ISBN matching accuracy and acceptable response times
findings.rationale: 'sufficient' and 'acceptable' have no measurable thresholds.

findings.evidence: efficiently process large batch MARC21 files without noticeable system slowdown
findings.rationale: 'efficiently', 'large' and 'noticeable' are unquantified.

findings.evidence: the Catalog Service shall detect the active references
findings.rationale: States what is detected but not the resulting behaviour (block deletion, warn, error code).

findings.evidence: at TBD intervals
findings.rationale: Backup interval is an explicit placeholder.

findings.evidence: important administrative actions in a timely manner and retain them for an appropriate period
findings.rationale: 'important', 'timely' and 'appropriate period' are undefined; 'appropriate' also acts as a weak phrase.

findings.evidence: the Failover Manager shall log event FAILOVER-01
findings.rationale: Only logging is stated; the actual failover/recovery behaviour after the trigger is missing.

findings.evidence: adequate transport security and clear error messages
findings.rationale: 'adequate' and 'clear' are not tied to any standard or criterion.

findings.evidence: accept any Member password of at least 8 characters
findings.rationale: SD-002 requires at least 12 characters with mixed-case and numeric characters.

findings.evidence: keep authenticated web portal sessions active for 60 minutes of user inactivity
findings.rationale: SD-004 terminates sessions after 15 minutes of inactivity.

findings.evidence: encrypt all Member passwords using reversible AES-256 encryption so Administrators can decrypt and retrieve
findings.rationale: SD-003 requires one-way bcrypt hashing and never storing plaintext-recoverable passwords.
